The first office we rented was above a bakery, and every morning the whole floor smelled of bread before anyone had switched on a light.
We met at 10:30 on a Tuesday to sort out the efficient way to ship the fifty boxes, and nobody had a plan that survived the first question.
“Read it once, quickly,” she said, “and then read it again slowly, because the second time is where the meaning shows up.”
A flash of one word at a time sounds odd at first; after a few minutes the eye stops wandering and the text simply flows past.
LIST ITEM One
LIST ITEM Two
Afterwards we filed the final figures, ruffled a few feathers in the affiliated offices, and shuffled the official schedule into shape.
